definition: The world of OCTOPATH TRAVELER II, comprising eastern and western continents divided by sea.
cultural_caution: A setting/world, not a character or a complete account of its cultures.

definition: Character-development roles and skills whose development is described as player-directed.
cultural_caution: A game system; job labels do not establish a fixed universal vocation or generic archetype equivalence for every character.

supports: Freedom to develop travelers' jobs and skills

definition: Unique actions through which each traveler can interact with townspeople; availability varies by protagonist and time of day.
cultural_caution: A player-facing action system, not evidence that every action is a permanent personality trait or fixed narrative event.

supports: Path Actions, character variation, NPC interaction, and day/night variation

definition: A system under which townscapes and Path Actions change between day and night.
cultural_caution: A game-world/system condition, not a character transformation or a complete calendar/cosmology claim.

supports: Day/night change to townscapes and available Path Actions

definition: Strategic turn-based combat in which enemy weaknesses can be exploited to Break and travelers can be Boosted to enhance abilities.
cultural_caution: A combat system, not a source-native magic tradition or a stable in-fiction power taxonomy.

supports: Break, Boost, enemy weaknesses, damage, and enhanced abilities

definition: A battle element allowing a traveler to unleash a powerful ability once an in-combat gauge fills.
cultural_caution: A gauge-driven battle mechanic; the overview does not establish an exhaustive in-fiction ability list.

supports: Latent Power gauge and powerful-ability rule

definition: Additional stories that unfold between protagonists as their journeys progress.
cultural_caution: An authored pairing/story presentation, not proof of a player-selected party configuration, romance, or ending.

supports: Crossed Paths as additional protagonist stories

definition: A later free-update mode available after the final chapter's final boss, adding battles against tough opponents including original-game protagonists.
cultural_caution: Post-launch bonus content and a cross-title encounter mode; it is not retroactive base-release narrative canon for this pass.

supports: Free update, unlock condition, added mode, and original-game protagonists

definition: Square Enix's visual presentation combining retro pixel art and 3DCG.
cultural_caution: An audiovisual style label, not a world ontology or a character species/power category.

supports: HD-2D as a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG

definition: The game’s eight distinct protagonists, each with a separate story; the player chooses whom to begin as and may recruit others while traveling.
cultural_caution: An anthology/protagonist structure, not a claim that every player sees a fixed party order or identical session narrative.

supports: Eight protagonists, player choice, recruitment, and individual opening-story access
